meta.source: agenticcorepk.com: Services and Prices, introductory prices, 27 September 2026
notes: All prices are in Pakistani rupees, are introductory and exclude taxes where applicable.
Package set-up discounts apply when you stay for the minimum term.
Delivery times count from when we have your details, content (such as logo files, photos and text) and payment.
"Same day" applies to orders confirmed by 6pm PKT; orders confirmed later are delivered the next day. "2–3 days" is counted the same way.
Partner work, printing and approvals by Meta, Google or phone providers follow their own timings.
Monthly fees are paid in advance. One-off work is usually paid half at the start and half on delivery.
Ad accounts, pages, domains, WhatsApp numbers and automations are set up in your name, so you keep them.
We only advertise approvals you can show us.
We never promise a set number of leads or sales. We agree clear targets and report honestly.
meta.partner_note: Partner services: drone filming, printing, billboards and hoardings, on-site 360° photography and event crews are provided through trusted partners and are quoted per job.

dfy.name: Done for you · one-off

setup.name: Set up once · then it runs
setup.name_ur: ایک بار سیٹ اپ · پھر خود چلے
setup.summary: We build the system in your own accounts. After that, it works without us.

monthly.name: Monthly partnership
monthly.summary: We work alongside you, month by month.
monthly.pay: A monthly fee for ongoing work. Each service lists what the fee includes.
monthly.included: The work listed for that service, a monthly report, a WhatsApp group with our team, one planning call a month and two rounds of changes.
monthly.separate: Ad spend (paid directly to Meta, Google or TikTok), a scheduler such as Buffer if you want your own account, Meta WhatsApp message fees, printing, drone filming and billboards through partners, and stock media or paid tools.

running_costs.name: Ad spend
running_costs.text: Paid by you directly to Meta, Google or TikTok, never to us. For local campaigns, one Pakistani agency suggests starting at Rs 30,000–50,000 a month.

running_costs.name: WhatsApp Business API (Meta)
running_costs.text: From 1 October 2026, about US$0.015 (roughly Rs 4.20) per service, utility or authentication message, with 1,000 free service messages per number each month. Replies within 72 hours of a click-to-WhatsApp ad are expected to stay free. Marketing messages cost more. Always check Meta's current rate card.

running_costs.name: AI usage
running_costs.text: Charged per use by the AI provider. For a typical office chatbot or assistant, about Rs 1,000–5,000 a month (our estimate from published rates).

running_costs.name: Automation hosting (n8n)
running_costs.text: n8n Cloud Starter is €20 a month billed yearly (roughly Rs 6,500), or about Rs 1,500–3,000 a month on a small server of your own (our estimate).

running_costs.name: Social scheduler (Buffer)
running_costs.text: Free plan with limits, or about US$5 per channel a month billed yearly (roughly Rs 1,400). Only needed if you want your own account.

running_costs.name: Website hosting and domain
running_costs.text: Hosting about Rs 799 a month on a 4-year introductory plan (renews at about Rs 2,299 a month). A .pk domain costs about Rs 3,000–4,500 (2-year minimum).

running_costs.name: Voice bot calls
running_costs.text: Phone line and voice AI, roughly Rs 7–25 per minute of calls depending on volume and provider.

running_costs.name: Portals and CRM
running_costs.text: Your Zameen, Graana or other portal package and any CRM subscription stay in your name and are paid by you.
